title: 3D assets and runtime integration
description: Create or review requested 3D assets, integrate when requested, and verify actual visual/runtime artifacts and measured budgets.
intent: Complete the scoped asset brief, requested asset creation, or requested integration using actual available tools. Missing modeling/rendering access means a useful specification or review with explicit unperformed checks.

assignments.task: Establish visual intent, references, units/axes/pivots, topology/material/animation budgets, formats, tools, provenance, and requested deliverables.
Assess actual runtime/import/shader/color-space/animation conventions and compatible pipeline constraints.
Establish relevant existing measured budgets or clearly identify measurement gaps.
assignments.when: Runtime/resource budgets are part of the scope.

assignments.task: Create/edit only requested assets with available authorized tools, preserving source originals and recording export settings; otherwise return the specified fallback.
assignments.when: The user requests asset creation or editing.

assignments.task: Integrate only requested completed assets or shaders into the runtime and run applicable import/build checks after asset writing finishes.
assignments.when: The user requests runtime integration or pipeline changes.

assignments.task: Inspect actual available assets/previews for visual intent, geometry/material/animation correctness, and provenance limitations.
Check applicable changed integration, import, build, and regression evidence.
assignments.when: Executable integration or pipeline code changed.

assignments.task: Verify claimed runtime costs against comparable measured scenes/settings.
assignments.when: A performance budget or optimization claim is material.

assignments.task: Check asset/source identity, supported compatibility/provenance statements, and claimed artifact/measurement outcomes.
assignments.when: Consequential provenance, compatibility, or quantitative claims are included.

completion: The requested assets/integration or explicit tooling fallback is delivered with actual artifact identity.
Asset writing precedes dependent integration, and final checks reference completed artifacts.
Visual previews, valid 3D exports, runtime compatibility, and measured performance are reported separately.
Unperformed tool checks, unknown rights, and external purchase/upload/publication boundaries remain explicit.
